planning_decision: Each cut uses a different category, activity, silhouette, expression, pose, orientation and framing. Direction/frame pairs differ from comparison cuts; at least one direction is new. Source influence multiset differs from comparison characters.
finalFacePrompt: FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): oval face, balanced length, medium width; soft rounded jaw; narrow eyes, medium size, level outer corners, close-set; straight medium brows; balanced nose; fuller lower lip.
faceRationale: Rounded lower jaw and fuller lower lip follow the rounded pelican volume; narrow level eyes and medium straight brows distinguish her from Wingull and the recent green-haired Grotle. Compared actual light images with hair/ornament region excluded in inspection.
